unresolved_ambiguities: The supplied source clauses identify C57BL/6 mice for the radiolabeled biodistribution study and Ai6 mice for the Cre-reporter study, but do not specify mouse strain or model for every anti-CD31 and anti-CD4 experiment; species/model claims were therefore not propagated across those experiment boundaries.

The supplied clauses establish anti-CD117 targeting and CD117-positive HSC phenotyping, but do not explicitly provide a gene/protein normalization for CD117; its normalized molecular-target name remains unresolved.

The anti-CD4 luciferase experiment reports enhanced spleen and reduced liver expression qualitatively, but no numerical outcomes or explicit assay timepoint are supplied in the source clauses; these were not fabricated.
